info.title: Ansa dashboard API
info.description: Self-service for a tenant organisation: its people, its agent's configuration, and its call history. Every request is scoped to one organisation by the session token that made it.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their organisation, and what they may do in it

401.description: No session, or a session that is no longer valid

post.summary: List the organisations an email and password can sign in to
post.description: Returns an empty list for a wrong password and for an address with no account, and takes the same time to do it.

422.description: The request did not match this endpoint's schema

429.description: Too many attempts; see the Retry-After header

delete.summary: Sign out, revoking the token that made this request
delete.description: Idempotent. The session row is kept and marked revoked, so it stays in the audit trail.

401.description: No session, or a session that is no longer valid

get.summary: List this organisation's calls, newest first
get.description: Filters combine with AND. `from` is inclusive and `to` exclusive, so two consecutive ranges do not both contain a call on the boundary. `reviewed` selects calls where somebody has ruled on at least one transcript.

401.description: No session, or a session that is no longer valid

403.description: The caller's role does not hold calls:read

get.description: Turns with their barge-in offsets, final transcripts with confidence and the provider that produced them, the event timeline ordered by offset, and the configuration version that served the call. There is no audio; see the API README.

401.description: No session, or a session that is no longer valid

post.summary: Record a review verdict on one transcript
post.description: Submitting the transcriber's own words back is a verdict, not a no-op: it marks the transcript reviewed and correct. `changed` says which it was.

get.summary: Quality metrics over this organisation's recent calls
get.description: Computed over the last 200 calls, from the same event log and the same arithmetic the internal viewer uses. Rates are strings so their precision is not rounded away, and null where the denominator was zero — no calls yet and no transfers are different readings.
